cards.headline: Dopaminergic modulation and L-DOPA in retinal disease

source.title: Dopaminergic modulation and L-DOPA in retinal disease: A scoping review of mechanistic, preclinical, and clinical evidence.
source.publisher: Progress in retinal and eye research
source.excerpt: Current evidence supports biological plausibility for dopaminergic modulation of retinal disease and indicates an encouraging safety profile for L-DOPA in early human studies. Larger trials are needed to determine efficacy, optimise dosing and route of administration and evaluate long term clinical outcomes.

cards.headline: Prediction Accuracy of the Buonsanti Artificial Intelligence Formula

source.title: Prediction Accuracy of the Buonsanti Artificial Intelligence Formula.
source.publisher: Journal of cataract and refractive surgery
source.excerpt: The Buonsanti AI formula provided high overall prediction accuracy, showing no major statistically significant differences compared with the established formulas in the ESCRS calculator. A small systematic myopic shift was present overall and was more pronounced in short eyes, supporting further evaluation with additional datasets and separately optimized constants.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence in Endodontics

source.title: Artificial Intelligence in Endodontics: A Narrative Review and Critical Synthesis of Diagnostic, Predictive, and Operational Applications.
source.excerpt: Technical performance has not yet been shown to translate into clinical benefit, and AI in endodontics should currently be used only as clinician-supervised decision support.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence in influenza prevention and control

source.title: Artificial intelligence in influenza prevention and control: translational pathways, supporting evidence, and system-level challenges.
source.excerpt: We propose phase-specific evidence thresholds, implementation-oriented evaluation metrics, an implementation readiness checklist, and priority evidence gaps for translating AI-enabled influenza tools into implementation-ready public health applications.

cards.headline: Global Research Trends at the Intersection of Macular Degeneration and Refractive Error

source.title: Global Research Trends at the Intersection of Macular Degeneration and Refractive Error: A Bibliometric and Visual Analysis.
source.excerpt: Macular degeneration and refractive error research has grown substantially over the past two decades. China leads in output, while the United States leads in citation impact and collaboration strength. This gap suggests that publication volume does not always translate into research influence. Artificial intelligence has emerged as a rising direction.

cards.headline: Als du zu den Gläubigen sagtest:„Genügt es euch denn nicht …

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:124
source.excerpt: اذكر -أيها النبي- ما كان من أمر أصحابك في «بدر» حين شقَّ عليهم أن يأتي مَدَد للمشركين، فأوحينا إليك أن تقول لهم: ألن تكفيكم معونة ربكم بأن يمدكم بثلاثة آلاف من الملائكة مُنْزَلين من السماء إلى أرض المعركة، يثبتونكم، ويقاتلون معكم؟

cards.arabic: إِذْ تَقُولُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَلَن يَكْفِيَكُمْ أَن يُمِدَّكُمْ رَبُّكُم بِثَلَـٰثَةِ ءَالَـٰفٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ مُنزَلِينَ
cards.translation: Als du zu den Gläubigen sagtest:„Genügt es euch denn nicht, daß euch euer Herr mit dreitausend herabgesandten Engeln unterstützt?
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: The Support of the Angels: The scholars of Tafsir differ over whether the promise contained in these Ayat referred to the battle of Badr or Uhud.

cards.headline: Ja doch!

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:125
source.excerpt: بلى يكفيكم هذا المَدَد. وبشارة أخرى لكم: إن تصبروا على لقاء العدو وتتقوا الله بفِعْل ما أمركم به واجتناب ما نهاكم عنه، ويأت كفار «مكة» على الفور مسرعين لقتالكم، يظنون أنهم يستأصلونكم، فإن الله يمدكم بخمسة آلاف من الملائكة مسوِّمين أي: قد أعلموا أنفسهم وخيولهم بعلامات واضحات.

cards.arabic: بَلَىٰٓ ۚ إِن تَصْبِرُوا۟ وَتَتَّقُوا۟ وَيَأْتُوكُم مِّن فَوْرِهِمْ هَـٰذَا يُمْدِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُم بِخَمْسَةِ ءَالَـٰفٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ مُسَوِّمِينَ
cards.translation: Ja doch! Wenn ihr standhaft seid und gottesfürchtig und sie unverzüglich über euch kommen, unterstützt euch euer Herr mit fünftausend gekennzeichneten Engeln.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: The Support of the Angels: The scholars of Tafsir differ over whether the promise contained in these Ayat referred to the battle of Badr or Uhud.

cards.headline: Allah machte es nur zu einer frohen Botschaft für euch …

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:126
source.excerpt: وما جعل الله هذا الإمداد بالملائكة إلا بشرى لكم يبشركم بها ولتطمئن قلوبكم، وتطيب بوعد الله لكم. وما النصر إلا من عند الله العزيز الذي لا يغالَب، الحكيم في تدبيره وفعله.

cards.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشْرَىٰ لَكُمْ وَلِتَطْمَئِنَّ قُلُوبُكُم بِهِۦ ۗ وَمَا ٱلنَّصْرُ إِلَّا مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
cards.translation: Allah machte es nur zu einer frohen Botschaft für euch, und damit eure Herzen dadurch Ruhe finden -, denn der Sieg kommt nur von Allah, dem Allmächtigen, dem Allweisen -,
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: Allah said "Allah made it not but as a message of good news for you and as an assurance to your hearts". This Ayah means, "Allah sent down angels and told you about their descent to encourage you and to comfort and reassure your hearts.

cards.body: Allah said "Allah made it not but as a message of good news for you and as an assurance to your hearts". This Ayah means, "Allah sent down angels and told you about their descent to encourage you and to comfort and reassure your hearts.
